# Best Microsoft Power Platform consultants in Newcastle, NSW

For an organisation in Newcastle and the Hunter region, I'd shortlist a mix of **local Microsoft specialists and established Australian Power Platform consultancies that can deliver projects in the region**\.

The key is to find a partner who can do more than build a Power App: they should understand Power Automate, Power BI, Dataverse, Microsoft 365 integration, security and ongoing support.

There isn't enough independent evidence to declare one firm definitively the best in Newcastle, so the shortlist below is based on publicly documented capabilities, Microsoft ecosystem experience and regional relevance.

## My shortlist



## 1\. Cloudhunter

(Best local starting point)

Regional specialist · Newcastle, Central Coast and Hunter Valley

Cloudhunter explicitly serves the Newcastle and Hunter region and lists Power Platform alongside Dynamics 365, SharePoint, Power BI and Azure. That regional coverage makes it a sensible first conversation if you value local delivery and broader Microsoft integration. [cloudhunter.com.au](https://cloudhunter.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Small and mid-sized organisations wanting Power Platform integrated with existing Microsoft systems.

**Website\:** [cloudhunter.com.au](https://cloudhunter.com.au/)

*Check\:* Ask for recent Power Apps and Power Automate projects specifically, and confirm whether consultants can attend your Newcastle site.

---

![Microsoft Power Platform Consulting | Professional Advantage Australia](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/48XBtHrA5K7KWOlgdQDeQUYV1XDG6Ir90ws6EprENn1_xGY6MltphUfvmSw1pWOY3k_H3jretBd6kxQwZmhTqt_IuUieQMJeHf89bqmp1oxX5fcQmsbkjiiOpqGo3HUkN1AEhDmmoaLrxhaPbmiDRoceQ3_izpZyyMTKC_Y9B4NVmI8KXMHn52HPgyQcmvx9?purpose=fullsize)

## 2\. Power Platform Experts

Specialist delivery · Australia-wide

A strong candidate when the core requirement is Power Platform itself. Its published services cover Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI and Power Pages, with integration into SharePoint, SQL and other systems. The company also publishes client testimonials describing workflow automation and post-project support. [www.powerplatformexperts.com.au](https://www.powerplatformexperts.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.powerplatformexperts.com.au](https://www.powerplatformexperts.com.au/about-us?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Custom business applications, workflow automation, reporting and replacing spreadsheet-driven processes.

**Website\:** [powerplatformexperts.com.au](https://www.powerplatformexperts.com.au/)

*Check\:* Request a comparable client reference and confirm travel and onsite support arrangements for Newcastle.

---

![Velratech | Technology Consultancy & Venture Studio](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/dq05-y08bTCzhNeIBhI4Z2MsmqHK4rLUPzaIUTpOvc_2Nhk-ZAVWBUIGcgcfXThLSReDtthp8PVl3Mdxa-GqHMyYlH5oOg4fyNSJOoYoCytN--cL4gRTyJ8JifK919oQ1YYvGslRM5y1HfsgY_b9AxP8yTZ9H8Xts_kc7IiAb9jTMr9ckfl-sKJgsEr212Kk?purpose=fullsize)

## 3\. Velrada

Enterprise transformation · National delivery

Velrada offers Power Platform, Dynamics 365, Azure, Microsoft Fabric and Copilot capabilities. Microsoft published a partner success story about its AI-powered low-code work in December 2025; it has also received significant recognition for its Dynamics 365 expertise. [microsoftpartners.microsoft.com](https://microsoftpartners.microsoft.com/abs/Individual-Partner-Success-Story/?title=Velrada+helps+customers+embrace+AI-powered+low-code+innovation&utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.wiise.com](https://www.wiise.com/partner-velrada?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Complex automation, integration, enterprise governance and solutions spanning multiple Microsoft products.

**Website\:** [velrada.com](https://velrada.com/)

*Check\:* Confirm the proposed delivery team, Newcastle availability and minimum project size.

---

![Newsroom | Akkodis](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/IjuYolc2Nv3mmxZ08Jvc_MEoxJNnpzApYc8eg9zT9LZLAeVapo6i_LEY52BPqgr3udwDwMSeOiZA3aRakVPrRcAZlZmTOUcQWmphtMg_hqXaPv3IfbOJns24oGXj6lTH5_mn23NhghgW28Rk-WhCg9IxefCQ_AMhPhXUHUCLCtWSGSYR_fDbSTgM4zxe5Fay?purpose=fullsize)

## 4\. Barhead Solutions

Business applications · CRM and automation

Barhead has a specialist background in Dynamics 365 and Power Platform, including customer-facing applications and low-code development. Its published industry recognition and broader business applications expertise make it worth considering when automation needs to connect closely with sales, service or CRM processes. [erpresearch.com](https://erpresearch.com/dynamics-partners/barhead-solutions?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.pwc.com](https://www.pwc.com/gx/en/news-room/assets/analyst-citations/isg-microsoft-australia-power-platform.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Dynamics 365 integration, customer service workflows and business process transformation.

**Website\:** [barhead.com](https://barhead.com/)

*Check\:* Verify the current trading and contracting arrangements following its acquisition by Akkodis, along with local delivery options.

---

![Antares (@AntaresSolution) on X](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NUT8Gzm9FLjCiAMGuUVU4Rusx-V1as3fX7Y5AZ1-32-LniLlrFlQGtdQQ7ei3VD777A2EXWSyEooPzsjaNus9bR4ksPP0H0KtaFA_5LyY92D3ThXt51PLJRHtkTdQaW0M-fxTA2_VPZUzxsX4Y3rIUijZGESGnPi2PF2geSutOjEkdqOpJq5sAIFTPOB8Eg8?purpose=fullsize)

## 5\. Antares Solutions

Microsoft 365 · Data and AI integration

Antares combines Power Platform with Microsoft 365, Power BI, Fabric, Azure AI and Copilot. Its published case studies include work for organisations such as Mission Australia and UNSW, providing useful evidence of experience in larger and more demanding environments. [www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Antares+Solutions/@-33.8640311,151.2120428,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x6b12ae3f15a614f1:0xf38b6a0da81f359a!8m2!3d-33.8640311!4d151.2120428!16s%2Fg%2F1wrgk9hv?hl=en&entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDQyOS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Solutions that combine workflow automation, reporting, collaboration and AI.

**Website\:** [antares.solutions](https://antares.solutions/)

*Check\:* Ask for a Power Platform case study relevant to your industry and confirmation of Hunter-region support.

## How I'd choose between them

| If your priority is… | Start with |
|--------|--------|
| Local access and regional knowledge | Cloudhunter |
| Power Platform-focused development | Power Platform Experts |
| Enterprise-scale transformation | Velrada |
| Dynamics 365 and CRM workflows | Barhead Solutions |
| Microsoft 365, data and AI integration | Antares Solutions |


These are **best-fit recommendations, not a verified ranking of delivery quality**\. Public information confirms the providers' stated capabilities, but does not establish comparative project success rates, pricing or customer satisfaction in Newcastle.

## What to ask before appointing a partner

I would request a short discovery call with your top two or three candidates and ask\:

- **Relevant experience\:** Can you show two recent Power Platform projects for organisations of similar size and complexity?
- **Delivery team\:** Who will actually design and build the solution, and what are their Microsoft certifications?
- **Governance and security\:** How do you handle development, testing, deployment, environment strategy, permissions and ongoing maintenance?
- **Commercial model\:** What is the estimated cost, what is excluded, and how will scope changes be handled?
- **Local support\:** Can you provide onsite workshops or support in Newcastle, and what response times do you commit to?

For larger implementations, ask for a demonstration of their approach to Power Platform's [official implementation guidance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/guidance/)\.

What kind of Power Platform work do you need help with? That would let me narrow this to the strongest two or three options rather than simply listing capable partners.
